panels.title: Controllers logged on (last 30 days)
panels.description: Controllers per rating group with more than 60 minutes online in total over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(sort, rank_group) AS (VALUES (2, 'S1'), (3, 'S2'), (4, 'S3'), (5, 'C1'), (7, 'C3'), (8, 'I1+')),
per_controller AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group, sum(duration_minutes) AS minutes
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY cid, rank_group
  HAVING sum(duration_minutes) > 60
)
SELECT r.rank_group, count(p.cid) AS controllers
FROM ranks r
LEFT JOIN per_controller p ON p.rank_group = r.rank_group
GROUP BY r.sort, r.rank_group
ORDER BY r.sort

panels.title: Controllers logged on each week, by rating group
panels.description: Controllers per rating group with more than 60 minutes online, for each calendar week (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', min(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS first_week,
         date_trunc('week', max(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS last_week
  FROM controller_session_ranked
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT g.w AS week_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
         greatest(b.first_week, date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         least(b.last_week, date_trunc('week', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         interval '1 week') AS g(w)
  WHERE b.first_week IS NOT NULL
),
per_controller AS (
  SELECT m.week_start, s.cid, s.rating
  FROM weeks m
  JOIN controller_session_ranked s
    ON (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.week_start
   AND (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  m.week_start + interval '1 week'
  GROUP BY m.week_start, s.cid, s.rating
  HAVING sum(s.duration_minutes) > 60
)
SELECT m.week_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'S1')  AS "S1",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'S2')  AS "S2",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'S3')  AS "S3",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'C1')  AS "C1",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'C3')  AS "C3",
       count(DISTINCT p.cid) FILTER (WHERE rank_group_of(p.rating) = 'I1+') AS "I1+"
FROM weeks m
LEFT JOIN per_controller p ON p.week_start = m.week_start
GROUP BY m.week_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: CTR and FSS controllers active (30 days to month end, monthly)
panels.description: Controllers who started a CTR or FSS session of more than 60 minutes in the 30 days to the end of each month.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', min(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS first_month,
         date_trunc('month', max(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS last_month
  FROM controller_session_ranked
),
months AS (
  SELECT g.m AS month_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
         greatest(b.first_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         least(b.last_month, date_trunc('month', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         interval '1 month') AS g(m)
  WHERE b.first_month IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT m.month_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) AS "Controllers"
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN controller_session_ranked s
       ON (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.month_start + interval '1 month' - interval '30 days'
      AND (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  m.month_start + interval '1 month'
      AND s.duration_minutes > 60
      AND s.is_ctr_fss
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Controllers active (30 days to week end, weekly)
panels.description: Controllers who started a session of more than 30 minutes in the 30 days to the end of each week (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', min(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS first_week,
         date_trunc('week', max(session_start) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS last_week
  FROM controller_session_ranked
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT g.w AS week_start
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(
         greatest(b.first_week, date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         least(b.last_week, date_trunc('week', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
         interval '1 week') AS g(w)
  WHERE b.first_week IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT m.week_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) AS "Controllers"
FROM weeks m
LEFT JOIN controller_session_ranked s
       ON (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.week_start + interval '1 week' - interval '30 days'
      AND (s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  m.week_start + interval '1 week'
      AND s.duration_minutes > 30
GROUP BY m.week_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 30 service providers (last 30 days)
panels.description: The 30 controllers with the most hours online over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(name ORDER BY session_start DESC))[1] AS controller,
       round((sum(duration_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Hours online"
FROM controller_session_ranked
WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND duration_minutes > 0
GROUP BY cid
ORDER BY sum(duration_minutes) DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Controllers with the shortest average session (last 30 days)
panels.description: The 15 controllers with the shortest average session length over the last 30 days, with at least 3 sessions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(name ORDER BY session_start DESC))[1] AS controller,
       round(avg(duration_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS "Average session (minutes)"
FROM controller_session_ranked
WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY cid
HAVING count(*) >= 3
ORDER BY avg(duration_minutes), cid
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top S1 service providers (last 30 days)
panels.description: The 30 S1 controllers with the most hours online over the last 30 days, regardless of the time selector. Each controller is listed once, under the highest rating they logged on with in the period, and all their hours count there.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(TRIM(MAX(name)), 'Unknown') || ' (' || cid || ')' AS controller,
       ROUND(SUM(session_duration_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS "Hours online"
FROM controller_summaries
WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
  AND session_duration_minutes > 0
  AND session_start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY cid
HAVING MAX(rating) = 2
ORDER BY SUM(session_duration_minutes) DESC, cid
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Controllers with the longest median session (last 90 days)
panels.description: The 15 controllers with the longest median session over the last 90 days, with at least 3 sessions of 5 minutes or more; shorter sessions are ignored.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_controller AS (
  SELECT cid,
         COALESCE((ARRAY_AGG(name ORDER BY session_start_time DESC NULLS LAST)
                  FILTER (WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> ''))[1], cid::text) AS name,
         CASE
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 2 THEN 'S1'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 3 THEN 'S2'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 4 THEN 'S3'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 5 THEN 'C1'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 7 THEN 'C3'
           WHEN MAX(rating) >= 8 THEN 'I1+'
           ELSE 'Unknown'
         END AS rating,
         ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY session_duration_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) AS median_hours
  FROM controller_summaries
  WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
    AND session_duration_minutes >= 5
    AND session_start_time >= now() - interval '90 days'
  GROUP BY cid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
  ORDER BY median_hours DESC, cid
  LIMIT 15
)
SELECT name || ' (' || cid || ', ' || rating || ')' AS controller,
       median_hours AS "Median session (hours)"
FROM per_controller
ORDER BY median_hours DESC, cid

panels.title: Controllers with the shortest median session (last 90 days)
panels.description: The 15 controllers with the shortest median session over the last 90 days, with at least 3 sessions of 5 minutes or more; shorter sessions are ignored.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_controller AS (
  SELECT cid,
         COALESCE((ARRAY_AGG(name ORDER BY session_start_time DESC NULLS LAST)
                  FILTER (WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name <> ''))[1], cid::text) AS name,
         CASE
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 2 THEN 'S1'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 3 THEN 'S2'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 4 THEN 'S3'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 5 THEN 'C1'
           WHEN MAX(rating) = 7 THEN 'C3'
           WHEN MAX(rating) >= 8 THEN 'I1+'
           ELSE 'Unknown'
         END AS rating,
         ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY session_duration_minutes)::numeric, 2) AS median_minutes
  FROM controller_summaries
  WHERE cid IS NOT NULL
    AND session_duration_minutes >= 5
    AND session_start_time >= now() - interval '90 days'
  GROUP BY cid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
  ORDER BY median_minutes ASC, cid
  LIMIT 15
)
SELECT name || ' (' || cid || ', ' || rating || ')' AS controller,
       median_minutes AS "Median session (minutes)"
FROM per_controller
ORDER BY median_minutes ASC, cid

panels.title: CTR hours staffed per week
panels.description: Total hours CTR positions (facility = 6, the VATSIM Enroute code) were staffed, per week.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       round(sum(duration_minutes) / 60.0, 1) AS "CTR hours"
FROM controller_session_ranked
WHERE facility = 6
  AND session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
